```{r}
# create matrix of random integers
answer_matrix <- matrix(sample(1:100, size=50, replace=TRUE), nrow=5, ncol=10)

# change column names
colnames(answer_matrix) <- c("cond1", "cond2", "cond3", "cond4", "cond5", "ctrl1", "ctrl2", "ctrl3", "ctrl4", "ctrl5")
rownames(answer_matrix) <- c("gene1", "gene2", "gene3", "gene4", "gene5")

# compute fold change
fcs <- c()
for (i in 1:5) {
  fcs <- c(fcs, rowMeans(subset(answer_matrix, select=c("cond1", "cond2", "cond3", "cond4", "cond5")))/rowMeans(subset(answer_matrix, select=c("ctrl1", "ctrl2", "ctrl3", "ctrl4", "ctrl5"))))
}
```
